meta_description: JW Plastering Services in Birmingham offers expert interior and exterior plastering, skimming, and rendering. Free quotes. Call 07742 500240 today.
hero_eyebrow: Expert Plasterer — Quality Finishes, On Time
hero_subhead: From interior skimming to exterior rendering, JW Plastering transforms your walls with precision and care.
services_subhead: Whether you need a single room skimmed or a whole property rendered, we deliver professional finishes on time and on budget.

services.title: Interior Skimming
services.desc: Perfect smooth finish for walls and ceilings. Ideal for new plasterboard, repairs, or refreshing tired surfaces. We leave your rooms ready to decorate.

services.title: Exterior Rendering
services.desc: Hard-wearing render that protects and enhances your home's exterior. Available in various finishes including sand and cement, polymer, and decorative options.

services.title: Plasterboard Installation
services.desc: Fast, precise installation of plasterboard for new partitions, ceilings, or extension work. Fully taped and jointed ready for finishing.

services.title: Artexing & Textured Finishes
services.desc: Create visual interest with textured ceiling and wall finishes. We can apply traditional Artex or modern alternatives to suit your décor.

services.title: Patch Repairs & Damage Restoration
services.desc: Cracks, holes, and water damage repaired seamlessly. We match existing finishes so repairs blend in invisibly with surrounding plaster.

services.title: Specialist Coatings
services.desc: Moisture-resistant plaster for bathrooms and kitchens. Fire-rated finishes for commercial and domestic compliance. We advise on the right product for your space.

about_pullquote: I take pride in work that lasts and finishes you'll be happy living with.
about_para_1: JW Plastering Services has been transforming homes and businesses across Birmingham for over 15 years. Starting as a one-man operation, we've grown through reputation alone — word-of-mouth from satisfied customers and repeat business from local developers and builders. Every job, whether a single bedroom or a new-build development, receives the same meticulous attention to detail.
about_para_2: Customers return to us because we finish on time, communicate clearly, and take pride in surfaces that look perfect from every angle. We're not the cheapest, but we're the most reliable — ask any of our regular clients or the local builders who book us months in advance.
reviews_heading: What Birmingham Homeowners Say About Us

reviews.text: Had our whole lounge skimmed before Christmas. JW was tidy, professional, and the finish is immaculate. Better than expected and reasonably priced. Already recommending to mates.
reviews.author: Mark T.

reviews.text: Exterior render needed doing on our 1930s semi. JW explained the options, didn't oversell, and the job looks brilliant. Three years on and it's held up perfectly. Top bloke.
reviews.author: Susan M.

reviews.text: Used JW for patch repairs after we had a leak. You'd never know anything had been wrong — he matched the texture perfectly and left the place spotless. Very professional.
reviews.author: David K.
